def _format_slice(x):
    if isinstance(x, slice):
        # Format slice objects as start:stop:step
        start = '' if x.start is None else str(x.start)
        stop = '' if x.stop is None else str(x.stop)
        step = '' if x.step is None else str(x.step)
        
        if x.step is None:
            return f'{start}:{stop}'
        else:
            return f'{start}:{stop}:{step}'
    else:
        # For non-slice objects, use bbrepr
        return bbrepr(x)
